sources.title: Numerically explicit estimates for the distribution of rough numbers
sources.enterprise_use: Provides modern explicit rough-number notation and the standard Phi(x,y) counting framework used as the prior-art neighborhood for P017 p-rough cofactor windows.
sources.not_claimed: Rough-number counting, Buchstab/de Bruijn functions, and their asymptotic theory are established sieve theory and are not Enterprise Math inventions.

sources.title: A note on variants of Buchstab's identity
sources.enterprise_use: Confirms Buchstab-type least-prime-factor recursion as established sieve machinery. P017 uses only an exact finite-interval specialization on its square-derived cofactor windows.
sources.not_claimed: Buchstab's identity, least-prime-factor sieve recursion, and its variants are established prior mathematics; the project only studies the additional constraints imposed by the square-basin moving windows.
